items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Carmen Carvallero I liked. He was very good.

ctx.x: Were there any musical styles you heard through radio that you had not been familiar with before?
I used to like Alec Templeton who had stolen some of Art Tatum’s runs. Carmen Carvallero I liked. He was very good. Earl Hines.
Tell me about this broadcast from the Grand Terrace.
